meta.title: kaaroSessions: Intelligence Graph for Claude Code Sessions
meta.subtitle: Five analytical views reveal the hidden topology of AI-assisted development across 12 projects and 75 sessions

report_card.summary: kaaroSessions is a single-file intelligence graph that transforms Claude Code session logs into five navigable analytical layouts. Across 12 projects and 75 sessions from April 19 to May 23 2026, kaaroViewer dominates by token volume while exp-art-of-mine-craft shows the highest burst activity. A 13.4× cache leverage ratio reveals both the efficiency and fragility of the kaaro development economy.

story.title: The Invisible Operator
story.narration: Claude Code sessions happen silently. Files appear, branches merge, tokens are consumed — but the developer has no structural view of their AI work history. kaaroSessions begins as kaaro's attempt to make the invisible topology of 75 sessions across 12 projects navigable as a graph.

story.title: One File, All Five Views
story.narration: kaaroSessions is a single self-contained HTML file. build.mjs injects the session graph at line 406 — a 437KB inline JSON object. Five layout modes unfold from this one artifact: force graph, swimlane, arc temporal coupling, file co-occurrence matrix, and 3D force graph, all driven by D3.js and Three.js.

story.title: 12 Projects, One Gravitational Field
story.narration: The force graph renders 12 projects as gravity wells pulling their sessions into orbit. kaaroViewer dominates: 21 sessions and 15.95M work tokens, nearly 36% of all AI work. exp-art-of-mine-craft surges with 11 sessions and 10.74M tokens in a concentrated burst, becoming the second-largest draw.

story.title: The Branch as Temporal Spine
story.narration: 61 git branch edges structure the swimlane view. Branches like `kaaro/feat/enrichment-pipeline` and `kaaro/paint` tell a story of iterative feature development across kaaroViewer sessions. The swimlane makes branch history spatial — who worked when, on which context — and the arc view adds a second axis: which files were touched across which sessions.

story.title: April 23: One Day, Four Sessions, 13 Errors
story.narration: On April 23 2026, four kaaroViewer sessions ran in a single day. The session `shiny-drifting-gem` alone accumulated 13 tool errors — the highest single-session error count in the graph. The arc view's temporal coupling map marks this day as a red nexus of file co-access, revealing a frenzied development burst that left a measurable error signature.

story.title: The Cache Economy: 599M Tokens for the Price of 44M
story.narration: Across 75 sessions, Claude Code delivered 599.7M cached tokens on just 44.8M tokens of actual work — a 13.4× leverage ratio. The best session (`immutable-cuddling-mango`) achieved 92.9% cache hit rate on 3.73M tokens_work. This cache economy is the invisible subsidy making the kaaro development pace sustainable; without it, token costs would collapse the budget by more than a factor of ten.

story.title: May 13: tidy-napping-stearns — The Largest Single Session
story.narration: On May 13 2026, `exp-art-of-mine-craft/tidy-napping-stearns` consumed 4.71M work tokens in a single session — the largest in the graph. The same project delivered 30 tool errors in `stateful-wishing-comet` the following day, revealing a burn-and-build pattern: maximum creative output paired with maximum operational friction. 4,317 total tool calls across the graph include 279 errors, a 6.5% failure rate that spikes in burst periods.

story.title: 524 Files as a Coupling Map
story.narration: The file co-occurrence matrix renders 524 files across 75 sessions as a heat map. Files that co-appear frequently across sessions reveal hidden architectural coupling — shared utilities, config files, and test harnesses that attract repeated edits across distinct work contexts. The arc view adds temporal depth: which files cluster across adjacent sessions vs. which are revisited months apart.

story.title: Live Intelligence: The Graph Stays Warm
story.narration: kaaroSessions connects to a local Claude Code SSE stream. When a session updates, the graph re-ingests `/graph-data.json` and re-renders live — in-flight sessions glow in `#00ffcc` on the bottom timeline bar. Hosted at kaaro.io/sessions, the tool becomes an active observatory rather than a static snapshot, closing the loop between active development and reflective analysis.

insights.title: kaaroViewer consumes 36% of all work tokens despite being only 28% of sessions, making it the defining project of this sprint
insights.body: 21 of 75 sessions but 15.95M of 44.8M total work tokens. The asymmetry reveals that kaaroViewer sessions are structurally heavier — longer context windows, more enrichment pipeline work, higher tool call density — than the average session across other projects.

insights.title: A 13.4× cache leverage ratio means any caching degradation would multiply kaaro's token costs overnight, exposing a critical cost fragility
insights.body: The entire kaaro development economy runs on 599.7M cached tokens serving 44.8M tokens of actual work. If cache hit rates dropped from 90%+ to 50%, operational token costs would increase by ~9× in a single sprint. kaaroSessions makes this fragility visible for the first time as a quantified risk.

insights.title: High-error sessions cluster inside high-output project bursts, suggesting that speed and correctness trade off at the session level
insights.body: exp-art-of-mine-craft produced the largest session (4.71M tokens_work) and the highest error count in a single session (30 errors) within consecutive days. The pattern repeats: sessions that push token volume also push error rates, visible in both the arc view and the tool_errors field per session node.

insights.title: The arc view's file-shared coupling mode surfaces architectural dependencies that git history cannot — making kaaroSessions a structural audit tool
insights.body: Files that co-appear across sessions reveal hidden dependencies invisible in linear commit history. When two files consistently appear together across sessions belonging to different branches, they signal implicit coupling that should either be formalized as a module boundary or broken apart. The matrix view cross-cuts this analysis across all 75 sessions simultaneously.

insights.title: kaaroSessions is itself built through 8 Claude Code sessions visible within the graph it renders, making the tool an embodied argument for AI-assisted development observability
insights.body: The kaaroSessions project (D--src-kaaroSessions) appears as a node in its own graph with 8 sessions and 4.71M work tokens. The tool that visualizes AI-assisted development is itself an artifact of AI-assisted development — observer and observed are entangled in a productive recursion.

insights.title: kaaroSessions transforms opaque LLM session logs into five navigable structural views, creating a new vocabulary for AI-assisted development intelligence
insights.body: By encoding sessions as nodes, files as nodes, and branches as edges in a force graph, kaaroSessions gives structural language to what otherwise exists only as text logs. Five layout modes cover spatial (force, 3D), temporal (swimlane), and coupling (arc, matrix) analytical perspectives — no single view tells the full story.

nodes.label: kaaroSessions
nodes.description: Single-file interactive intelligence graph that visualizes Claude Code development sessions. Injects a 437KB session graph via build.mjs and renders five analytical views — force, swimlane, arc, matrix, 3D — from one HTML artifact. Hosted at kaaro.io/sessions.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.description: Anthropic's AI coding assistant that generates the session data kaaroSessions visualizes. Each Claude Code session produces tokens_work, tokens_cached, tool_calls, tool_errors, git_branch, and file access records that feed the graph.

nodes.label: kaaroViewer
nodes.description: The dominant project in the session graph: 21 sessions spanning April 19 to May 23 2026, consuming 15.95M work tokens — 36% of all AI work. Skills registered: insights, kaaro-design, note, reload-plugins, visualize. The primary development target driving kaaro's AI usage.

nodes.label: kaaro
nodes.description: Developer and creator of the kaaro ecosystem: kaaroViewer, kaaroSessions, ebrain, ebrain-gardener, art-of-intent, and exp-art-of-mine-craft. Twitter: @karx_brb. The sole author whose Claude Code sessions populate the entire graph.

nodes.label: Force Graph
nodes.description: Default layout of kaaroSessions. Projects become gravity wells with tunable strength (0.06); sessions orbit their parent project. D3 force simulation with charge, collision, and link forces. Color-coded by project, node size scaled by token volume.

nodes.label: Swimlane View
nodes.description: Branch-organized temporal timeline. Each git branch becomes a horizontal lane; sessions appear as bars scaled by token volume or tool calls. Reveals the chronological shape of feature development, branch lifetimes, and parallel work streams.

nodes.label: Arc Temporal Coupling
nodes.description: Temporal coupling map with three modes: file-shared (sessions touching the same files), branch lineage (git ancestry arcs), and session sequence (chronological adjacency). Reveals hidden structural coupling between sessions across time.

nodes.label: File Co-occurrence Matrix
nodes.description: Files × sessions heat map. Rows are files (filtered by minimum session_count), columns are sessions. Cell color encodes access type: write (#00ff88), edit (#ffcc00), read (dim blue). Exposes 524 files across 75 sessions as a structural coupling map.

nodes.label: 3D Force Graph
nodes.description: Three.js powered 3D force-directed layout. Projects and sessions rendered as spheres with orbit forces, connected by WebGL edge lines. Provides spatial depth for understanding graph topology that the 2D force layout compresses.

nodes.label: exp-art-of-mine-craft
nodes.description: Experimental Minecraft-related project and the second-largest consumer of AI work in the sprint. 11 sessions, 10.74M tokens_work. Notable sessions: tidy-napping-stearns (4.71M tokens_work — largest single session) and stateful-wishing-comet (30 tool errors — highest error count). Skills: kaaro-design.

nodes.label: ebrain
nodes.description: Personal knowledge base / second brain project. 9 sessions, 4.25M tokens_work. Skills: garden. Notable session: quirky-churning-wilkes (1.34M tokens_work, 14 tool errors — the brain development is error-prone but generative).

nodes.label: Cache Hit Rate
nodes.description: Percentage of tokens served from Anthropic's prompt cache rather than recomputed. Peaks at 92.9% in the session immutable-cuddling-mango. Across all 75 sessions, cached tokens (599.7M) are 13.4× the work tokens (44.8M), representing the core economic efficiency metric of the kaaro development practice.

nodes.label: Tokens Work
nodes.description: Tokens consumed as active AI computation rather than served from cache. The true cost metric. Total across 75 sessions: 44.8M tokens. Largest single session: 4.71M (tidy-napping-stearns). kaaroViewer accounts for 15.95M (36%) of all work tokens.

nodes.label: D3.js
nodes.description: Data-Driven Documents — the core visualization library powering force graph, swimlane, arc, and matrix views in kaaroSessions. D3 force simulation manages node positions, collision detection, and link forces across the 2D views.

nodes.label: ebrain-gardener
nodes.description: Knowledge gardening companion to ebrain. 9 sessions, 3.56M tokens_work. Skills: kaaro-design, simplify. Notable session: ethereal-weaving-karp (1.45M tokens_work, 10 errors). Second most active project after kaaroViewer and exp-art-of-mine-craft.

nodes.label: art-of-intent
nodes.description: Intent-focused project. 6 sessions, 2.46M tokens_work. Skills: effort, insights, simplify. Active from April 24, 2026. Session 4d497c90 was the first to register a named skill (insights) in the timeline.

nodes.label: kaaroSkills
nodes.description: Skills management project for the kaaro ecosystem. 2 sessions, 1.32M tokens_work. Notable session: recursive-tumbling-waterfall (681K tokens_work). The project that builds and maintains custom Claude Code skills used across all kaaro projects.

nodes.label: karx-github-io
nodes.description: Personal website / portfolio project. 5 sessions, 1.21M tokens_work. Part of the kaaro.io ecosystem visible in the session graph.

nodes.label: Three.js
nodes.description: WebGL 3D rendering library powering the 3D force graph view in kaaroSessions. Renders sessions and projects as spheres with orbit forces and WebGL edge lines, adding spatial depth to the D3-based 2D layouts.

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events
nodes.description: Web API (EventSource) enabling kaaroSessions to receive live updates from Claude Code projects. When a session changes, the graph re-fetches /graph-data.json and re-renders — turning kaaroSessions from a static snapshot into a live observatory.

nodes.label: Tool Error Rate
nodes.description: Frequency of tool call failures within Claude Code sessions. 279 errors across 4,317 calls — a 6.5% baseline rate that spikes during high-output burst sessions. Visualized per session in the force graph and swimlane views.

nodes.label: Tool Diversity
nodes.description: Count of distinct tool types used within a session. The first named session (immutable-cuddling-mango) used 11 distinct tool types across 239 calls. Tracked as tool_diversity per session node; contributes to session complexity scoring.

nodes.label: Git Branch
nodes.description: Organizational axis for the swimlane and arc views. 61 branch edges in the graph encode git ancestry relationships between sessions. Branches like kaaro/feat/enrichment-pipeline and kaaro/paint appear as horizontal lanes in the swimlane, making feature development history spatial.

nodes.label: kaaroSessions (project)
nodes.description: The development project building the kaaroSessions visualization tool — visible as a node within its own output. 8 sessions, 4.71M tokens_work. Skills: init, kaaro-design, recap, simplify, web-seo. Last active May 23 2026.

nodes.label: Tokens Cached
nodes.description: Total tokens served from Anthropic's prompt cache across all sessions: 599.7M. The difference between this and tokens_work (44.8M) defines the 13.4× leverage ratio. Cached tokens represent computation paid for on previous turns and reused free.

nodes.label: Skills System
nodes.description: Custom Claude Code skills attached to projects and sessions. Skills like visualize, kaaro-design, insights, simplify, web-seo appear in the GRAPH data as arrays per project and session. Built in kaaroSkills project; defines kaaro's specialized AI vocabulary.

nodes.label: First Session
nodes.description: April 19 2026 — the earliest session in the graph. kaaroViewer/immutable-cuddling-mango: 3.73M tokens_work, 92.9% cache hit rate, 239 tool calls, 11 tool types, 6 errors. Sets the benchmark for the sprint.

nodes.label: April 23 Burst
nodes.description: April 23 2026 — four kaaroViewer sessions in a single day. Session shiny-drifting-gem: 1.2M tokens_work and 13 tool errors, the highest single-session error count at this point in the sprint. Visible in the arc view as a file co-access nexus.

nodes.label: Largest Session
nodes.description: May 13 2026 — exp-art-of-mine-craft/tidy-napping-stearns: 4.71M tokens_work, the largest single session in the 35-day sprint. The following day, stateful-wishing-comet produced 30 tool errors — the graph's highest. Represents the peak of creative and operational intensity.

nodes.label: Graph Snapshot
nodes.description: May 23 2026 — the date of the kaaroSessions encoding. Last active sessions: kaaroSessions (recency: 0.9999), kaaroViewer (recency: 0.99999), exp-art-of-mine-craft (recency: 0.9986). The graph represents 35 days of AI-assisted development activity.

nodes.label: kaaro.io
nodes.description: The kaaro web platform hosting kaaroSessions at kaaro.io/sessions. The canonical URL referenced in Open Graph metadata, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD schema. Provides the public deployment target for the visualization.
